Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2020 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of HD.
We generated $15.6 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2020.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $3.31 per share.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 14% to 20% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Thank you for the question. We delivered record revenue of $26.3 billion this quarter, representing 14% year-over-year growth.
Second question - Analyst:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
